card.name: The word "amount" and its forms
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the word "amount" or its forms (amounts, amounting, AMOUNT), especially before "to". It also fires on the pieces "mt", "T" and "ont" inside names and abbreviations.

modes.label: Amount forms
modes.description: Forms of "amount" that mean 'comes to' or 'a quantity', often followed by "to".

modes.label: Name pieces
modes.description: Short pieces inside personal names or abbreviations, such as Lamont or AMT.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mixed and give no clear picture of what is added.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "amount" and its forms, and on a few odd name or abbreviation pieces.
